model.title: Security model
model.keysBody: Your recovery phrase and private keys are generated and stored only on this device — never uploaded.
model.signBody: Transactions are signed on-device after biometric approval. Nothing to sign ever leaves the phone.
model.backendBody: Only your public address is shared — for cached prices, address risk checks and transaction simulation.

txProtection.title: Transaction protection
txProtection.heading: Suspicious activity protection
txProtection.sub: Screens recipients & contracts before you sign
txProtection.lowBody: Known address, verified contract — safe to proceed.
txProtection.cautionBody: New address or unverified contract — review carefully.
txProtection.highBody: Flagged for scams or drains — signing is blocked.
